a.lede: Security researchers used AI tools to help uncover years-old vulnerabilities in the PHP web scripting language. Then the AI-assisted attacks began.
a.title: The PHP Meltdown Shows How AI Makes Bugs More Exploitable

b.lede: From AI-discovered PHP vulnerabilities to flaws in Node.js and popular AI tool LiteLLM, cybersecurity teams have plenty to worry about this week.
b.title: The internet is having a very bad cybersecurity day
